name: OneMillion-Bench
intro: OneMillion-Bench 是覆盖金融、法律、医疗、自然科学和工业五大领域的高经济价值专业智能体基准。400 个中英文任务由领域专家通过三阶段流程构建，并经多模型对抗筛选、同行评审、第三专家仲裁和难度双向截断。
build_method: 三阶段多专家标注, 前沿智能体对抗筛选, 难度双向截断, 专家量规与负向惩罚
metric: Expert Score, Pass Rate, Economic Value
eval_feature: 逐标准专家量规, -20至10非对称权重, 能力标签与领域聚合
scale: 400个任务, 5个领域, 37个子域, 92个三级类别；英文全球集与中文本地集各200题
intro_en: OneMillion-Bench is a high-economic-value professional-agent benchmark spanning finance, law, healthcare, natural science, and industry. Its 400 English and Chinese tasks are built through a three-stage domain-expert pipeline with multi-agent adversarial filtering, peer review, third-expert resolution, and bidirectional difficulty truncation.
build_method_en: Three-stage Multi-expert Annotation, Frontier-agent Adversarial Filtering, Bidirectional Difficulty Truncation, Expert Rubrics with Negative Penalties
metric_en: Expert Score, Pass Rate, Economic Value
eval_feature_en: Criterion-level Expert Rubrics, Asymmetric -20-to-10 Weights, Capability Tags and Domain Aggregation
scale_en: 400 tasks, 5 domains, 37 subdomains, 92 tertiary categories; 200 English Global and 200 Chinese local-context tasks
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["先在法律、金融、工业、医疗、自然科学五个领域定义高价值专家任务"] --> B["由领域专家整理 400 个开放式任务"]
    B --> C["为每个任务指定时间限制、引用要求与专业约束"]
    C --> D["要求代理检索权威来源并汇总证据"]
    D --> E["在冲突证据下进行规则适用与约束决策"]
    E --> F["生成完整且可执行的专业回答"]
    F --> G["按 factual accuracy、logical coherence、practical feasibility、professional compliance 打分"]
    G --> H["汇总不同领域下代理的专业可靠性与实用准备度"]
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Define economically consequential expert tasks across law, finance, industry, healthcare, and natural science"] --> B["Curate 400 open-ended tasks with domain experts"]
    B --> C["Attach time constraints, citation requirements, and professional rules to each task"]
    C --> D["Require agents to retrieve authoritative sources and assemble evidence"]
    D --> E["Resolve conflicting evidence and make constraint-aware decisions"]
    E --> F["Produce complete, useful professional deliverables"]
    F --> G["Score outputs on factual accuracy, logical coherence, practical feasibility, and professional compliance"]
    G --> H["Aggregate agent reliability and practical readiness across domains"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2603.07980 and the official OneMillion-Bench dataset. The diagrams preserve five professional domains, 37 subdomains, and 92 tertiary categories; expert task, reference-answer, and rubric creation; semi-open, multi-solution, time-invariant design; concurrent adversarial validation across frontier-agent families; independent same-subdomain peer review and consensus revision; third-expert resolution of risky or disputed cases; lower-bound elimination and upper-bound review; rubric criteria, asymmetric -20-to-10 weights, capability tags, and verified sources; the 400-task bilingual release with 200 English Global and 200 China-specific tasks; vanilla, search-enabled, and deep-research systems; Web Search, Reasoning, Verbalization, and Instruction Following rubric tags; weighted clipped Expert Score, Pass Rate, balanced domain aggregation, and estimated economic value.
